name: Gaea Seed
summary: Along Mirkfallon Lake, Gaea Seeds offer a way to heal Stonetalon's wounded land. Tauren shamans value the hardy kernels for restoring places scarred by war and industry.

sections.title: Vessels of Renewal
sections.body: Gaea Seeds wash ashore or grow along Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains. Small and fibrous, they look like coconuts, yet endure harsh conditions. As conflict and industry scar the land, shamans see the seeds as a means to heal it.

sections.title: Blessings of the Earthmother
sections.body: At Sun Rock Retreat, the tauren shaman Tammra Windfield gathers Gaea Seeds to counter the destruction across the peaks. Shamans use traditional chants and elemental rites to bless the dormant husks with the Earthmother's power. That blessing hastens their growth, making them hardy saplings able to take root in scorched, barren ground such as the Charred Vale.

faq.answer: Gaea Seeds wash ashore along Mirkfallon Lake, in the mountains north of Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon.

faq.q: What are Gaea Seeds used for?
aliases: what does tammra do with gaea seeds
faq.answer: At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield gathers Gaea Seeds for an elemental blessing. The blessed seeds help restore plant life in devastated places such as the Charred Vale.

faq.q: Why do shamans need to imbue the seeds?
faq.answer: Fire, warfare, and logging have badly damaged parts of Stonetalon. The Earthmother's power quickens the seeds' growth and strengthens them to take root in ruined soil.

faq.q: What do Gaea Seeds look like?
faq.answer: Gaea Seeds look like small, brown, rounded husks or coconuts along the water's edge of Mirkfallon Lake.

angles.text: As a shaman, you see how elemental rites and the Earthmother's blessing can hasten growth and help heal damaged land.
As a tauren, you share the people of Sun Rock Retreat's sacred duty to heal land damaged by outside warfare and lumbering.
